items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: I played with Tate at the Metropolitan Theater.

ctx.x: Yeah, you played with Tate then for a while.

I played with Tate at the Metropolitan Theater. What? About 1928, 29, and 30. We played, well, legitimate music, you know, besides jazz. We did presentation work in the pit. And we played background music for the pictures. It was during the silent days then. So I got pretty familiar then with the different overtures and classical numbers.
Can you tell a bit about Heinz band when you were in quite a long time?
